pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Develop your chosen race through normal play. Switching races or mastering every race is not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Choice, successful powers and mastery belong to one race owner. Reselection follows native screen eligibility; quests neither grant a race nor require cycling through all five.
